context._comment_format: JSON has no comments. Per-block documentation lives in sibling '_comment_<block>' keys placed immediately before the block they describe. Anything starting with '_comment' is ignored at runtime — no code reads those keys.
context._comment_project_name: Used as the resource-name prefix for every stack (e.g., '<project>-<region>') and as the SSM parameter path root for cross-region ALB hostname registration.
context._comment_deployment_regions: Where each stack class deploys. 'global' hosts Global Accelerator, ECR, S3, and the cross-region SSM hostname registry. 'api_gateway' and 'monitoring' often co-locate with 'global' but can be split. 'regional' is the list of EKS clusters; one regional stack per entry.
context._comment_tags: Common tags applied to every stack and resource that supports tagging (cost-allocation, ownership, compliance). Add or override here. WARNING: every key in this block becomes a literal AWS tag — do not add documentation keys here.
context._comment_eks: EKS cluster version and access posture. GCO runs EKS Auto Mode (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/automode.html), so node provisioning is managed by AWS — GPU/inference/EFA/Neuron compute is steered via the Karpenter NodePool manifests in lambda/kubectl-applier-simple/manifests/ (40-* through 44-*).
context._comment_kubernetes_version: EKS minor version. kubectl in Dockerfile.dev should track this within the ±1 minor skew policy (https://kubernetes.io/releases/version-skew-policy/).
context._comment_eks_cluster: endpoint_access controls who can reach the EKS API server. PRIVATE = inside the VPC only (production posture). Set to PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE for kubectl access from the internet during dev. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md (EKS Endpoint Access).
context._comment_global_accelerator: AWS Global Accelerator front door. health_check_grace_period: seconds before a new endpoint starts being probed. health_check_interval: seconds between probes. health_check_timeout: seconds to wait per probe. health_check_path: HTTP path probed on each regional ALB. client_affinity: 'NONE' (default, spreads connections across endpoints) or 'SOURCE_IP' (pins a client IP to the same endpoint). See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoint-groups-health-check-options.html and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html#about-listeners-client-affinity.
context._comment_backend_tls: Mandatory authenticated TLS from the proxy Lambdas through Global Accelerator/direct regional routing to each internal ALB. GCO creates a deployment-local ECDSA root CA in a customer-managed-KMS-encrypted secret, publishes only its public trust bundle, and imports short-lived signed leaves into regional ACM. The scheduled manager reimports renewed leaves into stable ACM ARNs. root_generation can be incremented for an explicit staged rollover; activation delay must exceed the maximum stale trust-cache window, and overlap must exceed leaf validity.
context._comment_alb_config: Internal ALB target-group health checks for the manifest-processor service. health_check_interval / health_check_timeout in seconds. healthy_threshold / unhealthy_threshold are the consecutive-probe counts before a target flips state. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html.
context._comment_api_gateway: Edge-optimized global REST API behavior plus direct-caller policy for the always-deployed per-region aggregation bridges. throttle_rate_limit (req/s) and throttle_burst_limit (peak burst) are stage caps. log_level applies to access/execution logs. metrics_enabled and tracing_enabled toggle CloudWatch metrics and X-Ray tracing. regional_api_enabled admits other IAM-authorized principals from this account to each bridge; the exact aggregator role is always admitted and bridge deployment is unconditional. Each VPC Lambda resolves the current internal ALB from the trusted SSM registry and uses private-root TLS. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md (Regional API Gateway).
context._comment_waf: WAFv2 web ACL in front of API Gateway. per_ip_rate_limit is the WAF rate-based rule's request budget per source IP over a 5-minute window. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-rate-based.html.
context._comment_vpc_endpoint_cidrs: CIDR blocks allowed to reach VPC endpoints, applied as NetworkPolicy egress rules in the cluster. Defaults to the VPC's own CIDR; widen to include peered VPC ranges if needed.
context._comment_workloads: Job submission, validation, and processing pipelines
context._comment_manifest_processor: Authenticated API, direct manifest submission, inference proxy, and DynamoDB queue worker. central_queue_worker_enabled activates queued Jobs in each target region. Claims use unique pod owners, fencing generations, deterministic Kubernetes identities, and renewable leases; lease_renewal_seconds must be no more than half lease_seconds. poll_interval_seconds controls pickup cadence; batch_size bounds each pass; reconcile_limit bounds pending/running status checks. max_request_body_bytes is the hard request-size cap (1 MiB default). yaml_max_depth limits YAML nesting. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md.
context._comment_queue_processor: SQS-backed job submitter. enabled: master toggle (when false the exact built-in ScaledJob is pruned). polling_interval: how often KEDA checks SQS. max_concurrent_jobs: maximum active consumer Jobs. messages_per_job: target queued messages per active Job for KEDA scaling; each worker still receives at most one message. successful_jobs_history / failed_jobs_history: K8s Job history caps.
context._comment_job_validation_policy: Shared validation policy applied by BOTH the REST manifest_processor (POST /api/v1/manifests) and the SQS queue_processor (gco jobs submit-sqs). CDK wires these values into both services at deploy time so a single change applies uniformly. An attacker holding sqs:SendMessage cannot bypass checks the REST path enforces. allowed_namespaces: namespaces a submitted manifest may target. resource_quotas: per-manifest caps applied before admission. trusted_registries / trusted_dockerhub_orgs: image source allowlist. manifest_security_policy.block_*: hardening flags rejecting privileged or host-namespace pods. allowed_kinds: K8s resource kinds the gateway will accept. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md (Security Policy Configuration).
context._comment_resource_quota: K8s ResourceQuota / LimitRange values applied to the gco-jobs namespace. max_*: namespace-wide ceilings. container_max_*: per-container ceilings (LimitRange). Tune these to match the cluster's expected multi-tenant footprint.
context._comment_resource_thresholds: Health monitor thresholds that drive the /api/v1/health regional capacity report. cpu_threshold / memory_threshold / gpu_threshold are utilization percentages above which the region is reported as 'busy'; set any to -1 to disable that dimension. pending_pods_threshold counts pods in Pending state. pending_requested_cpu_vcpus / pending_requested_memory_gb / pending_requested_gpus sum unscheduled resource requests across pending pods.
context._comment_images: ECR image registry. removal_policy: 'retain' keeps repos when the stack is destroyed (production default); 'destroy' wipes them. empty_on_delete: only honored with removal_policy='destroy'; if false, non-empty repos block stack deletion. lifecycle.keep_tagged: number of most-recent tagged images retained. lifecycle.expire_untagged_days: untagged image TTL in days. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/LifecyclePolicies.html.
context._comment_volcano_image_mirror: Optional credential-free fix for Volcano's docker.io-only images (volcanosh/vc-*), which on a cold cluster pull slowly / hit Docker Hub rate limits and can stall Volcano's helm install. When enabled, the regional stack redirects Volcano's basic.image_registry to <account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com/<ecr_namespace> (which defaults to <project_name>/dockerhub and must start with <project_name>/ so it inherits the project's <project_name>/* node-pull access, replication, and trusted-registry allow-list), and 'gco stacks deploy' auto-mirrors the pinned images into that namespace before the regional Helm install (or run 'gco images mirror --region <region>' manually). The copy preserves the full multi-arch manifest list (docker buildx imagetools / Finch --all-platforms / skopeo). Unlike an ECR pull-through cache this needs no Docker Hub secret; it is a static mirror you refresh when the Volcano chart version changes. See docs/IMAGE_MIRROR.md.
context._comment_storage: Optional storage backends (disabled by default; flip enabled then 'gco stacks deploy-all').
context._comment_fsx_lustre: FSx for Lustre filesystem mounted into job pods. enabled: master toggle. storage_capacity_gib: provisioned size. deployment_type: SCRATCH_1, SCRATCH_2 (recommended), or PERSISTENT_*. file_system_type_version: Lustre version. per_unit_storage_throughput: only relevant for PERSISTENT_* (MB/s/TiB). data_compression_type: NONE or LZ4. import_path / export_path: optional S3 data-repo URIs. auto_import_policy: which S3 events trigger metadata sync (NONE, NEW, NEW_CHANGED, NEW_CHANGED_DELETED). See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md (Configure FSx Storage) and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html.
context._comment_s3_access_logs: Retention (days) for S3 server-access-log buckets. Logs older than this are expired by a bucket lifecycle rule. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/enable-server-access-logging.html.
context._comment_addons: Optional add-on services (toggle enabled, then deploy-all to provision)
context._comment_valkey: ElastiCache Serverless Valkey (Redis-compatible) cache. enabled: master toggle. max_data_storage_gb / max_ecpu_per_second: serverless usage caps (cost ceiling). snapshot_retention_limit: days of automatic backups retained. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md (Configure Valkey Cache) and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html.
context._comment_aurora_pgvector: Aurora Serverless v2 PostgreSQL with pgvector. enabled: master toggle. min_acu / max_acu: Aurora Capacity Unit range; min_acu=0 enables scale-to-zero. backup_retention_days: automated backup TTL. deletion_protection: blocks accidental cluster deletion when true. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md (Configure Aurora pgvector) and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html.
context._comment_analytics_environment: SageMaker Studio / HyperPod / Canvas analytics stack. enabled: master toggle (off by default). hyperpod.enabled / canvas.enabled: opt-in subfeatures. cognito.domain_prefix: optional custom Cognito UI domain (null = auto). cognito.removal_policy / efs.removal_policy: 'destroy' wipes user pools and EFS on stack delete (dev default); 'retain' preserves them. studio.user_profile_name_prefix: optional Studio user-profile name prefix. See docs/ANALYTICS.md and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/studio-updated.html.
context._comment_cluster_observability: Self-hosted in-cluster observability (kube-prometheus-stack: Prometheus + Alertmanager + Grafana) installed on every regional EKS cluster via the Helm installer. enabled: master toggle, ON BY DEFAULT (set false to opt out). Grafana uses native auth (no self sign-up, no anonymous) and is reachable privately via 'gco monitoring open' (kubectl port-forward to a ClusterIP service — no public endpoint; the EKS API is PRIVATE, so a VPN/SSM/bastion path is required). grafana/prometheus/alertmanager.persistence_size: EBS PVC sizes. prometheus.retention: TSDB retention window. grafana.admin_password_rotation_schedule: cron for the in-cluster CronJob that rotates the chart-generated Grafana admin password (default monthly, 04:00 on the 1st). This is complementary to the CloudWatch gco-monitoring stack; see docs/MONITORING.md.
context._comment_helm: Helm chart installation toggles. Each key maps to one or more charts in lambda/helm-installer/charts.yaml; flip enabled=false to skip a chart. Charts install in dependency order with kueue last (its mutating webhook intercepts every Job/Deployment). Cross-scheduler coexistence is documented in docs/SCHEDULERS.md.

helm._comment_keda: KEDA — Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling. MANDATORY platform component (no toggle): it backs GCO's built-in SQS queue processor and is the metrics bridge (keda-metrics-apiserver serves external.metrics.k8s.io) that lets autoscalers consume GPU/CloudWatch metrics. KEDA is always installed and is intentionally not listed below — see docs/KEDA.md.
helm._comment_aws_efa_device_plugin: AWS EFA device plugin — exposes Elastic Fabric Adapter as a schedulable resource (vpc.amazonaws.com/efa) for HPC/ML jobs that need low-latency multi-node networking. Upstream: https://github.com/aws/eks-charts/tree/master/stable/aws-efa-k8s-device-plugin.
helm._comment_aws_neuron_device_plugin: AWS Neuron device plugin — exposes Trainium / Inferentia chips as schedulable resources (aws.amazon.com/neuron). Upstream: https://github.com/aws-neuron/neuron-helm-charts.
helm._comment_volcano: Volcano — batch scheduler purpose-built for AI/ML and HPC: gang scheduling, fair-share queues, priority. Pods opt in via schedulerName: volcano. See docs/VOLCANO.md.
helm._comment_kuberay: KubeRay operator — runs Ray clusters and Ray Jobs as Kubernetes resources for distributed Python / ML workloads. See docs/KUBERAY.md.
helm._comment_cert_manager: cert-manager — issues and rotates TLS certs for cluster webhooks. Required by kueue and several other charts. Upstream: https://cert-manager.io/docs/.
helm._comment_slurm: Slurm-on-Kubernetes via the Slinky operator. Off by default. See docs/SLURM_OPERATOR.md.
helm._comment_yunikorn: Apache YuniKorn — alternative batch scheduler with hierarchical queues. Pods opt in via schedulerName: yunikorn, so it coexists cleanly with Volcano and the default scheduler. Off by default. See docs/YUNIKORN.md.
helm._comment_kueue: Kueue — job-queueing layer for fair sharing across teams. Must install last because its mutating webhook intercepts every Job/Deployment. See docs/KUEUE.md.

context._comment_inference_monitor: Long-running controller that reconciles InferenceEndpoint desired state into Deployments, Services, autoscaling objects, and supporting configuration. Direct per-endpoint Ingresses are forbidden; reconciliation removes any legacy ones so inference stays behind the shared authenticated proxy. reconcile_interval: seconds between reconciliation passes (also drives the leader-election lease duration). unhealthy_threshold_seconds: how long an endpoint may stay NotReady before the monitor emits an explicit degraded-state warning while the proxy returns 503. See docs/INFERENCE.md.
context._comment_mcp_server: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server IAM role provisioning. enabled: when true, the regional stack creates a least-privilege role and exports its ARN as the McpServerRoleArn CFN output. Operators set GCO_MCP_ROLE_ARN to that exported value when launching the MCP server. See gco_mcp/README.md and https://modelcontextprotocol.io/.
context._comment_drift_detection: CloudFormation drift detection schedule. enabled: master toggle. schedule_hours: EventBridge rate (hours) at which the drift-detection Lambda runs and publishes findings to SNS. See docs/RUNBOOKS.md and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/detect-drift-stack.html.
context._comment_historical: Historical capacity surface - an OPTIONAL ADD-ON to the global stack (not a separate stack), enabled by default. When enabled, GCOGlobalStack adds a DynamoDB time-series table plus an EventBridge-scheduled Lambda that snapshots spot scores, prices, AZ coverage, and capacity-block availability. Set enabled=false to opt out. retention_days: DynamoDB TTL window for snapshots. poll_interval_minutes: schedule cadence. capacity_block_duration_hours: short Capacity Block probe duration (default 24 = 1 day, soonest-available). capacity_block_long_duration_hours: long Capacity Block probe duration in hours (default 1512 = 63 days) so history tracks extended-term block availability; set 0 to disable the long probe. watch_instance_types: instance types to snapshot. enabled_regions: regions to poll (empty = all deployed regions). Cost is ~0 within the Lambda free tier; see lambda/capacity-poller/README.md.
context._comment_cdk_flags: CDK feature flags (do not modify unless upgrading CDK)
